purpose: Teach: オアシス/戦没/豪雪

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「砂漠のオアシスは命を支える」って教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, you know, Dad taught me that a desert oasis is what keeps life going.
lines.style: Soft hushed opening, leaning in like sharing something precious. Gentle reverence on the quote.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと戦没者追悼の祈りを捧げたよ
lines.en: Mei, I said a prayer with Daddy for all the people who died in the war.
lines.style: Small earnest voice, careful and proud. Slight pause before the big word, then pushing through.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「豪雪地帯の人々の暮らし」を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's going to teach us about how people live in the heavy-snow country.
lines.style: Warm unhurried promise. Melodic dip at the line end, painting the snow country gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「砂漠オアシス」の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei, Daddy and I read a picture book about a desert oasis!
lines.style: Brightening now, quick eager lift on the picture book. Shy pride tucked under the excitement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「戦没者を忘れない事の大切さ」を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad will teach you how important it is to never forget the people we lost in the war.
lines.style: Slow tender closing. Quiet weight on the words, voice softening almost to a hush.
